about: 导演语法的『触发表』（用户 2026-10-16：「把导演语法写进简报和分镜的规则和检查（章节节奏目标、露脸位置、触发表、拍内快切）」）：旁白线索 → 这一拍该给什么画面。storyboard.mjs checkStoryboard 在分镜检查时读取本表并逐拍运行；改一条触发是改数据，不是改代码。章节节奏目标/露脸位置/拍内快切由 routing/rhythm-by-role.json + checkStoryboard 的 measureChapter 与短刀/蒙太奇检查执行。

placeholders.{cue16}: 命中的原文前 16 字加省略号
placeholders.{broll}: 有 b-roll 母题时给出它的描述与检索词，否则为空

categories.quote: quote-portrait-bw / quote-stack / title-word-broll / title-hero-over-photo / presenter-tags / stamp-over-evidence
categories.title: 任何 title- 开头的卡

triggers.say: a list / exclusion line ("{cue16}"); cut each item (scenes, 0.4–0.8 s a cut)

triggers.cue: 另外一个问题|另一个问题|第二个问题|第一个问题|两个问题|我们先来看|接下来|说到这儿|聊到这儿|问题就来了|更好奇|最反常识
triggers.say: a question / turn line ("{cue}"); the presenter carries it

triggers.cue: 那套说法|这套说法|有人说|外界|媒体|普遍认为|大家都说|舆论|报道称|网上都
triggers.say: the line cites what others say ("{cue}"); show the headlines (news card, a collage of real headlines)

triggers.cue: 钱多|没数花|疯了|离谱|吓人|慌成|难以置信|不敢相信|失眠|炸了
triggers.say: an emotional / exaggerated line ("{cue}"); cut to the film's b-roll motif{broll} with footage-plate

triggers.cue: 宣布|发消息|群里|朋友圈|发了一条|官宣
triggers.say: an announcement / message ("{cue}"); show it as a chat thread (chat-thread), bubble by bubble

triggers.cue: 两个问题|两种看法|两个信仰|两条路|两种可能|两个选择
triggers.say: the line sets out "{cue}"; put them as two poster cards on either side of the presenter (poster-pair) and hold

triggers.cue: 叫做|所谓|称为|起了个名字|凭什么|错了|恰恰相反|甚至不是|根本不是
triggers.say: a concept / reversal word ("{cue}"); give it a big title cut (title-word-broll / title-hero-over-photo)

triggers.cue: 原话|说过|他说|她说|评价了一句
triggers.say: someone's own words; show the quote (quote card or big type)
